metadata.ruleset: AACR GENIE / cBioPortal Mutual Exclusivity & Co-occurrence Log-Odds
metadata.derivation_rationale: Derived from published pan-cancer sequencing cohorts (GENIE / cBioPortal) because Stage 01 tabular data does not contain individual patient-level variant co-alteration matrix entries.

EGFR___KRAS.biological_rule: Simultaneous untreated de-novo EGFR and KRAS driver alterations are extremely rare (<0.2%).

EGFR___ALK.biological_rule: Concomitant EGFR and ALK driver rearrangements occur in <0.5% of cases.

EGFR___TP53.biological_rule: Frequent co-alteration; correlated with shorter duration of response to EGFR TKIs.

KRAS___STK11.biological_rule: Predictor of primary resistance to single-agent immune checkpoint blockade.

BRAF_V600E___NRAS.biological_rule: Mutually exclusive MAPK pathway activation in melanoma baseline.

EGFR_Sensitizing___EGFR_T790M.biological_rule: T790M emerges predominantly in cis with sensitizing Exon 19 del or L858R.

EGFR_T790M___EGFR_C797S.biological_rule: C797S emerges under osimertinib pressure in T790M-positive tumors.
